description: Deploy the zoth/public/ hub as a dedicated subdomain on Hostinger, leaving nullai.tech apex untouched.
notes: Do not rsync to public_html/ directly; everything lands under public_html/studio/ so the apex remains intact.
The studio subdomain should be created in hPanel before rsync runs.
Enable Let's Encrypt SSL for studio.nullai.tech in hPanel after files are in place.
Never upload vault daemon, agent-comms, or any file containing GITHUB_TOKEN or HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN.
After first successful sync, verify with the smokecheck-checklist.md before updating DNS.

audit_findings.p1_summary: 12 public fetch/probe calls and JSON-LD links still point to 127.0.0.1:8484/8787/8765; see agent-comms/handoffs/hermes-sensitive-tree-audit.md for exact files/lines.
